verses.text: Then they seized him, and led him, and brought him into the high priest’s house. But Peter was following afar off.
And when they had kindled a fire in the midst of the court, and had sat down together, Peter sat in the midst of them.
And a certain maid seeing him as he sat towards the light, looked steadfastly upon him, and said, This man also was with him.
And he denied him, saying, Woman, I know him not.
And after a little while another saw him, and said, Thou art also of them. And Peter said, Man, I am not.
